stage1_interaction_analysis.architectural_takeaway: When Stage 1 correctly identifies building and floor (88.5% of cases), local k-NN filtering reduces median coordinate error from 6.97 to 6.74 units. However, when Stage 1 is wrong (11.5% of cases), unthresholded local k-NN forces neighbors in the wrong building/floor, causing errors to rise from 15.08 to 18.51 units. Confidence-gating (tau=0.70) successfully mitigates this penalty by falling back to global k-NN on uncertain predictions, reducing mean error to 9.98 units.
